headline: The list lacks a way to prove what P&I changes
subline: Q3 · What I would add to the list, and why

sub: Without it, SoW and CM3 gains cannot be attributed

bullets.text: North Star driver tree and forecast
sub: Enrolment x level-up rate minus drops: is 125k reachable?

bullets.text: AI foundations: metric API, decision log, testing
sub: Includes GDPR and AI Act checks before Brain scales

bullets.text: Go Big monitoring in the first weeks
sub: Volume doubles; data and drops must be watched daily

annotation: All four run inside the top 5; none needs a separate team.
source: Source: case study brief (Nov 2026); P&I proposal.
notes: Four things I would add to the list. First and most important: a way to prove impact. Holdout groups for every campaign and list; without them we will never convince Finance that SoW and CM3 moved because of us.
Second, a North Star driver tree: enrolment, level-up rate and drops. It tells us whether 125 thousand is reachable and which lever gets us there.
Third, the AI foundations from the users slide: metrics available through an API, every recommendation and its outcome logged, and testing, including GDPR and the AI Act, before Brain scales.
Fourth, monitoring in the first weeks of Go Big, when volume doubles. None of these needs a separate team; they are built into the top 5.
